about: The BR-51's old magazine as a player action's prop (docs/native_guns/br51_animation_redo_v1.md 5.6): the gun's own empty_old_mag bone, drawn by the gun renderer where the action places this prop (gun_part); its frame is the gun's (the magazine seated when it sits on the gun prop unturned), same scale. Points: top (the magazine pivot, its front lug in the receiver's front catch, which it rocks about), base (the base plate). Written by tools/author-br51-01-reload-actions.mjs.
